information_flow: The first call receives all common evidence and emits one complete executable closure with immutable public-contract conformance. The final call consumes that closure and public non-anchor evidence, begins with behavior-semantic revision authority, and transitions to contract-preserving full internal reconstitution authority only upon the specified non-representability trigger. The final call emits one policy.
name: Contingent Reconstitution Authority Relay
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one contract-locked executable handoff and one evidence-triggered terminal authority transition
